appName.description: Extension name shown in Chrome and the Web Store. Do not translate.

appDesc.message: Gmail の印刷画面で、アカウント欄・件名・送信元・日時・宛先を隠し、本文だけを印刷できるようにします。
appDesc.description: Extension description shown in Chrome and the Web Store (max 132 characters).

popupLang.description: BCP 47 language tag of this locale, set as <html lang> of the popup. Use the tag of the translation language (e.g. "ja"), not a translated word.

popupHint.message: チェックした項目だけ印刷に残します。未チェックは非表示です。
popupHint.description: Hint at the top of the popup explaining that checked items are printed and unchecked ones are hidden.

popupFormLabel.description: Accessible label (aria-label) of the checkbox list in the popup.

itemAccount.message: アカウント欄（ロゴ・自分のアドレス）
itemAccount.description: Checkbox label: the account bar at the top of the print page (Gmail logo and the user's own address).

itemSender.description: Checkbox label: the sender's name and address.

itemDate.description: Checkbox label: the date and time of each message.

itemRecipients.description: Checkbox label: the recipients (To/Cc) and reply-to lines.

errorSave.description: Shown in the popup when saving the setting fails. $ERROR$ is the error text.

errorLoad.message: 設定の読み込みに失敗しました: $ERROR$
errorLoad.description: Shown in the popup when loading the saved setting fails. $ERROR$ is the error text.

errorInit.message: 初期化に失敗しました: $ERROR$
errorInit.description: Shown in the popup when the popup fails to start. $ERROR$ is the error text.
